title: 그래서
part: Relaciones lógicas y modalidad básica — 논리 관계와 기본 양태
articleMarkdown:
#### En pocas palabras

The Korean Basic Dictionary defines **그래서** as a word used when the preceding content is the cause, basis, or condition for what follows. This entry is limited to that relation; it does not claim that every two consecutive events are causally linked.

#### Fuentes y localizadores

National Institute of Korean Language. (s. f.). 그래서. In *Korean Basic Dictionary*. National Institute of Korean Language. https://krdict.korean.go.kr/eng/dicMarinerSearch/search?mainSearchWord=%EA%B7%B8%EB%9E%98%EC%84%9C&nation=eng

Korean Basic Dictionary, search entry 그래서¹, definition: preceding content is cause, basis, or condition for following content.

#### Entradas relacionadas

Se relaciona con **-아/어서**, que también puede expresar causa o secuencia dentro de una construcción verbal, y contrasta funcionalmente con conectores como **하지만** y **그런데**, que introducen oposición o un giro respecto de lo anterior.
